_comment: Baseline-model registry for the bake-off UI picker (GET /curation/bakeoff/baseline_models). Domain-neutral: only the quantized ONNX variants of your own trained model (produced by the bake-off job's quantize step). Domain baselines belong to a profile -- see examples/<name>/baselines.json and BakeoffProfile.baselines_path, or point OP_BAKEOFF_BASELINES_PATH at your own file. Add a model = append an entry (no code change). 'weights' paths are placeholders relative to the evaluator container's working directory; replace them with your own. 'mode' may be full|crop|both.
